articles.title: Slow growth as a strategy for plant longevity
articles.abstract: Abstract Ecological theories predict a fundamental trade-off between fast growth and the probability of achieving longevity, with far-reaching consequences for ecosystem resilience and carbon residence time. Tree-ring studies have revealed a globally consistent negative relationship between growth rate and lifespan, yet comparable large-scale evidence for such trade-offs beyond trees remains scarce, largely due to methodological limitations. Here, we exploit annual growth rings formed by secondary thickening in perennial herbaceous plants to test whether the growth–longevity trade-off represents a widespread axis of plant strategies extending across life forms. Using an extensive dataset of over 3100 herbaceous and small woody species, including lianas, sampled across five continents and ecosystems ranging from the Arctic to hot semideserts, we reveal a robust association between slow growth and longevity across life forms and environmental conditions. Moreover, the growth rate exhibited a strong temperature dependence, giving rise to an apparent longevity–temperature relationship, highlighting ecological relevance of growth–longevity coupling. Together, our findings identify the growth–longevity trade-off as a widespread constraint on plant strategies, with important implications for predicting vegetation dynamics, ecosystem stability, and the persistence of terrestrial carbon storage in a changing climate.
articles.title_zh: 缓慢生长是植物长寿的策略
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 生态理论预测了快速增长和实现长寿的可能性之间的基本权衡，这对生态系统的恢复力和碳停留时间产生了深远的影响。树木年轮研究揭示了生长率和寿命之间全球一致的负相关关系，但树木以外的这种权衡的可比大规模证据仍然很少，这主要是由于方法学的局限性。在这里，我们利用多年生草本植物二次增厚形成的年轮来测试生长与寿命的权衡是否代表了跨生命形式的植物策略的广泛轴。我们利用从五大洲和从北极到炎热的半沙漠的生态系统采样的超过 3100 种草本和小型木本物种（包括藤本植物）的广泛数据集，揭示了不同生命形式和环境条件下的缓慢生长与长寿之间的紧密关联。此外，生长速率表现出强烈的温度依赖性，产生明显的寿命-温度关系，凸显了生长-寿命耦合的生态相关性。总之，我们的研究结果表明，生长与寿命的权衡是对植物策略的广泛限制，对于预测植被动态、生态系统稳定性以及气候变化中陆地碳储存的持久性具有重要意义。

articles.title: Public institutions for cleantech commercialization in the United States
articles.abstract: Abstract The United States has been building public institutions to promote cleantech commercialization since the 1970s oil crisis. The ascent of new industrial policy has accelerated this process substantially since 2020, resulting in a doubling of the total number of institutions by 2024. Introducing a dataset of 122 institutions, we show how institutions perform five functions: goal setting, coordination, derisking, imposing discipline, and external engagement. Further, we demonstrate how post-2020 institutions extend and diverge from historical trends, highlighting the recent buildout of planning capacity, the widespread use of conditionalities, and the pivot toward engagement with local and non-firm actors. We conclude with an analysis of how the second Trump administration is transforming the cleantech commercialization system through retrenching, redesigning, repurposing, and maintaining institutions. We offer a bottom-up, institution-level examination of the emergence and evolution of state capacity for green industrial policy in the United States, its functions, and current developments.
articles.title_zh: 美国清洁技术商业化的公共机构
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 自 20 世纪 70 年代石油危机以来，美国一直在建立公共机构来促进清洁技术商业化。自 2020 年以来，新产业政策的兴起大大加速了这一进程，到 2024 年机构总数将增加一倍。通过引入 122 个机构的数据集，我们展示了机构如何履行五项职能：目标设定、协调、去风险、施加纪律和外部参与。此外，我们还展示了 2020 年后的机构如何延伸和偏离历史趋势，强调近期规划能力的建设、条件的广泛使用以及转向与当地和非企业参与者的接触。最后，我们分析了特朗普第二届政府如何通过紧缩、重新设计、重新利用和维护机构来改变清洁技术商业化体系。我们对美国绿色产业政策国家能力的出现和演变、其职能和当前发展进行自下而上的机构层面研究。

articles.title: Engineered polymerase-mediated efficient synthesis of site-specifically functionalized RNA and 2’-modified RNA oligonucleotides via genetic alphabet expansion
articles.abstract: Abstract 2’-Modified RNA oligonucleotides have found broad use in biotechnology and biomedicine, requiring their efficient synthesis and controllable labelling. While engineered polymerases enable their synthesis, controllable labelling methods remain underdeveloped. Unnatural base pairs (UBPs) have been developed to expand the genetic alphabet, leading to not only the creation of semi-synthetic organisms, but also technologies for site-specific labelling of DNA and RNA. Herein we demonstrate that SFM4-6, an engineered polymerase optimized for 2’-modified RNA oligonucleotide synthesis, can efficiently synthesize unnatural base pair dNaM (2-methoxy-3-(2’-deoxy-β-D-erythro-pentofuranosyl)-naphthalene)-dTPT3 ((2’-deoxy-β-D-erythro-pentofuranosyl)-thieno[3,4]pyridine-2-thione) and its analogues, enabling site-specific incorporation of functionalized unnatural base-containing nucleotides into RNA and 2’-modified RNA oligonucleotides. By combining this with a strategy involving controlled pause and restart of primer extension, we establish methods for producing single or dual-labelled RNA and 2’-modified RNA oligonucleotides. These methods successfully produce various functional labelled RNA and 2’-modified RNA oligonucleotides, highlighting their broad applicability in nucleic acid research and biotechnology.
articles.title_zh: 通过遗传字母表扩展，工程聚合酶介导的位点特异性功能化 RNA 和 2’-修饰 RNA 寡核苷酸的高效合成
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 2'-修饰的 RNA 寡核苷酸在生物技术和生物医学中有着广泛的用途，需要它们的高效合成和可控标记。虽然工程聚合酶能够合成它们，但可控标记方法仍然不发达。非自然碱基对 (UBP) 的开发是为了扩展遗传字母表，不仅催生了半合成生物体，还催生了 DNA 和 RNA 定点标记技术。在此，我们证明了 SFM4-6（一种针对 2'-修饰 RNA 寡核苷酸合成进行优化的工程聚合酶）可以有效合成非天然碱基对 dNaM (2-甲氧基-3-(2'-脱氧-β-D-赤式-呋喃戊糖基)-萘)-dTPT3 ((2'-脱氧-β-D-赤式-呋喃戊糖基)-噻吩并[3,4]吡啶-2-硫酮)及其类似物，能够将功能化的非天然含碱基核苷酸定点掺入RNA和2'-修饰的RNA寡核苷酸中。通过将其与涉及引物延伸的受控暂停和重新启动的策略相结合，我们建立了生产单标记或双标记 RNA 和 2’-修饰 RNA 寡核苷酸的方法。这些方法成功生产了各种功能性标记RNA和2'-修饰RNA寡核苷酸，凸显了它们在核酸研究和生物技术中的广泛适用性。

articles.title: Modulating pressure in the Orbitrap improves sensitivity and mass resolution in charge detection mass spectrometry
articles.abstract: Abstract Native mass spectrometry has become a key method for studying macromolecular assemblies, providing insights into structures, stoichiometries, and binding interactions. A key aspect for the transmission of electrospray-generated bioparticles into the mass analyzer is the use of gas for collisional cooling and ion desolvation. However, in Orbitrap-based mass spectrometry, the elevated pressure may negatively affect ions, as collisions with background gas can destabilize ion trajectories, potentially leading to incorrect mass determination. These effects are amplified when the pressure in the collision cell is high, as required for large biological assemblies, and when ions are measured for (ultra)long acquisition times in the Orbitrap, as required for high-resolution mass spectrometry. To address these issues, we modified a standard Q Exactive™ UHMR by installing a pulsed valve to control gas flow and limit gas leakage into the Orbitrap. This way, ion transmission and desolvation are maintained while the ultrahigh vacuum in the mass analyzer is enhanced during acquisition. We show that this improves ion detection of various assemblies, including adeno-associated viruses, IgM, and plasmid DNA, with superior mass accuracy and resolving power. The pulsed valve implementation will benefit nearly all mass measurements, setting the stage for next-generation Orbitrap-based, single-ion mass spectrometry.
articles.title_zh: Orbitrap 中的调节压力可提高电荷检测质谱的灵敏度和质量分辨率
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 天然质谱已成为研究大分子组装体的关键方法，提供对结构、化学计量和结合相互作用的见解。将电喷雾产生的生物颗粒传输到质量分析器中的一个关键方面是使用气体进行碰撞冷却和离子去溶剂化。然而，在基于 Orbitrap 的质谱分析中，升高的压力可能会对离子产生负面影响，因为与背景气体的碰撞可能会破坏离子轨迹的稳定性，可能导致错误的质量测定。当碰撞池中的压力较高时（如大型生物组件的要求），以及当离子在 Orbitrap 中测量（超）长采集时间（如高分辨率质谱的要求）时，这些效应会被放大。为了解决这些问题，我们修改了标准 Q Exactive™ UHMR，安装脉冲阀来控制气体流量并限制气体泄漏到 Orbitrap 中。这样，离子传输和去溶剂化得以维持，同时质量分析器中的超高真空在采集过程中得到增强。我们表明，这改善了各种组装体的离子检测，包括腺相关病毒、IgM 和质粒 DNA，具有卓越的质量精度和分辨率。脉冲阀的实施将有利于几乎所有质量测量，为下一代基于 Orbitrap 的单离子质谱奠定了基础。

articles.title: Geophysical evidence of a nearly dry bridgmanite in the Earth’s lower mantle
articles.abstract: Abstract Water in Earth’s mantle plays a crucial role in shaping geological and geochemical processes. While previous electrical conductivity measurements on major mantle minerals have constrained water content in the Earth’s mantle down to the mantle transition zone, the water content of the lower mantle remains experimentally unconstrained. This study measures the electrical conductivity of hydrous (Fe,Al)-bearing bridgmanite, synthesized with Fe and Al compositions representative of peridotitic lithology, at pressures up to 47 GPa and temperatures up to 2210 K. The results demonstrate that proton conduction is the predominant charge transport mechanism in hydrous (Fe,Al)-bearing bridgmanite under the investigated pressure-temperature conditions. Water incorporation markedly enhances the electrical conductivity of bridgmanite, increasing it by approximately an order of magnitude relative to that of dry samples. Extrapolation of the experimental data suggests that bridgmanite in the lower mantle contains less than 40–70 wt. ppm H 2 O near the top and at mid-mantle depths. These findings offer insight into potential hidden water reservoirs in Earth’s lower mantle.
articles.title_zh: 地球下地幔中近乎干燥的桥石的地球物理证据
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 地幔中的水在地质和地球化学过程中起着至关重要的作用。虽然之前对主要地幔矿物的电导率测量将地幔中的水含量限制在地幔过渡区，但下地幔的水含量在实验上仍然不受限制。本研究测量了在高达 47 GPa 的压力和高达 2210 K 的温度下，用代表橄榄岩岩性的 Fe 和 Al 成分合成的含水 (Fe,Al) 桥锰矿的电导率。结果表明，在所研究的压力-温度条件下，质子传导是含水 (Fe,Al) 桥锰矿的主要电荷传输机制。水的掺入显着增强了桥石的电导率，相对于干燥样品的电导率增加了大约一个数量级。实验数据外推表明，下地幔中的桥锰矿含有少于 40-70 wt.%。 ppm H 2 O 靠近顶部和中地幔深处。这些发现让我们深入了解地球下地幔中潜在的隐藏水库。

articles.title: Bony labyrinth morphology reveals deep population history and isolation among Homo sapiens in prehistoric northeastern Africa (44–3 ka)
articles.abstract: Abstract Understanding the population history of Homo sapiens in northeastern Africa has been hindered by the scarcity of human remains and ancient DNA data. Here, we analyse bony labyrinth morphology, a reliable proxy for population affinities, in 148 individuals dating from the Late Pleistocene to the Late Holocene from the Nile Valley region, the Horn of Africa, Central Africa, comparative Pleistocene fossils from Africa and Eurasia, and recent South Africans. Shape analyses reveal morphological continuity among Middle Nile Valley foragers and close affinities with earlier African H. sapiens fossils, suggesting deep regional ancestry. In contrast, local Neolithic food producers exhibit distinct morphologies, supporting a major demographic shift beginning 8000 years ago. A subgroup of Early Holocene Nile Valley foragers displays unusual bony labyrinth morphology and congenital inner ear-specific pathological changes consistent with possible syndromic conditions. This may result from several demographic scenarios, including prolonged endogamy and geographic isolation under environmental constraints. Comparative data from the Horn of Africa and Central Africa reveal high morphological diversity, suggesting strong population substructure and dynamic demographic trajectories during the Holocene. These findings provide rare insights into prehistoric population structure in the region, and demonstrate the usefulness of bony labyrinth morphology where ancient DNA is unavailable.
articles.title_zh: 骨迷路形态揭示了史前非洲东北部智人的深厚人口历史和隔离（44-3ka）
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 由于人类遗骸和古代 DNA 数据的稀缺，了解非洲东北部智人的人口历史一直受到阻碍。在这里，我们分析了来自尼罗河谷地区、非洲之角、中非的更新世晚期至全新世晚期的 148 个个体的骨迷路形态，这是人口亲缘关系的可靠代表，来自非洲和欧亚大陆的比较更新世化石，以及近代的南非人。形状分析揭示了中尼罗河谷觅食者的形态连续性，以及与早期非洲智人化石的密切亲缘关系，表明了深厚的区域血统。相比之下，当地新石器时代的粮食生产者表现出独特的形态，支持了 8000 年前开始的重大人口转变。全新世早期尼罗河谷觅食者的一个亚群表现出不寻常的骨迷路形态和先天性内耳特异性病理变化，与可能的综合症条件一致。这可能是由多种人口统计情况造成的，包括长期同族通婚和环境限制下的地理隔离。来自非洲之角和中非的比较数据揭示了高度的形态多样性，表明全新世期间强大的人口亚结构和动态的人口轨迹。这些发现为该地区史前人口结构提供了罕见的见解，并证明了骨迷路形态在无法获得古代 DNA 的情况下的有用性。

articles.title: Tailored living mycelium macerate for reproducible flexible actuators
articles.abstract: Abstract The integration of living attributes, such as self-renewal and responsiveness, into structural materials remains a fundamental challenge, as they typically preclude the mechanical robustness required for practical applications. Here, we report a fungal-based maceration tailored strategy to create living mycelium materials with exceptional mechanical properties and programmable humidity responsiveness. The developed materials demonstrate wide-range adjustable tensile performance, achieving 11 ~ 349% elongation and 0.1 ~ 18.0 MJ·m −3 toughness, the highest values reported among flexible mycelium materials. Through multiscale characterization from microstructural to molecular levels, we revealed the hygroscopic deformation mechanism of Janus mycelium macerates which arises from asymmetric hygromechanics and entropy-driven reorganization. Crucially, these materials retain their living functionalities, enabling reversible dormancy-regeneration cycles in 1 year and inheritable Janus structure along with self-renewal of performance. Moreover, we demonstrate their ability to convert environmental humidity fluctuations into quantifiable electrical signals, highlighting their potential as biohybrid environmental sensors and interactive platforms. This interdisciplinary study represents an integrative paradigm in living material design, and exhibits substantial potential for future sustainable and intelligent applications at the intersection of living mycelium materials and ecologically sustainable devices.
articles.title_zh: 用于可重复柔性执行器的定制活菌丝体浸渍
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：将自我更新和响应能力等生命属性整合到结构材料中仍然是一个基本挑战，因为它们通常会妨碍实际应用所需的机械鲁棒性。在这里，我们报告了一种基于真菌的浸渍定制策略，以创建具有卓越机械性能和可编程湿度响应性的活菌丝体材料。所开发的材料表现出宽范围可调的拉伸性能，实现了11 ~ 349%的伸长率和0.1 ~ 18.0 MJ·m -3 的韧性，这是柔性菌丝体材料中报道的最高值。通过从微观结构到分子水平的多尺度表征，我们揭示了Janus菌丝体浸渍物的吸湿变形机制，该机制源于不对称湿度力学和熵驱动的重组。至关重要的是，这些材料保留了其活性功能，能够在一年内实现可逆的休眠-再生循环，并具有可遗传的 Janus 结构以及性能的自我更新。此外，我们展示了它们将环境湿度波动转换为可量化电信号的能力，突出了它们作为生物混合环境传感器和交互式平台的潜力。这项跨学科研究代表了生物材料设计的综合范例，并在生物菌丝体材料和生态可持续设备的交叉领域展示了未来可持续和智能应用的巨大潜力。

articles.title:
Vector-Controlled
*CO Transport Drives Efficient Urea
Electrosynthesis
articles.abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic coupling of carbon dioxide and nitrate provides a sustainable route for urea synthesis. However, constrained by the ambiguous intermediate reaction pathways, such systems typically require a highly negative potential (≤ −0.5 V vs RHE) to achieve high urea yields. This inevitably results in prohibitive electricity expenses, which account for approximately 48% of the total expenditure for urea electrosynthesis and represent a major bottleneck hindering this promising approach. Herein, a vector-controlled *CO intermediate transport strategy is reported to direct the coupling pathway. This strategy realized an anodic potential shift of 300 mV and a remarkable urea yield of 2927 μg h–1 cm–2 at −0.2 V (vs RHE), outperforming most reported electrocatalysts. Techno-economic analysis reveals that this process reduces energy consumption and cuts electricity costs by over 25%. This unidirectional *CO transport is achieved via a precisely engineered CuAg interface, where a tailored asymmetric local electronic environment with a d-band center difference of 1.64 eV induces a *CO adsorption energy difference of 0.8 eV. This enables continuous *CO desorption from weakly adsorbing Ag sites and unidirectional transport to strongly adsorbing Cu sites, thus facilitating the critical *NOCO formation. This work establishes a promising pathway for energy-saving urea synthesis.
articles.title_zh:
矢量控制
*二氧化碳运输推动高效尿素
电合成
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 二氧化碳和硝酸盐的电催化偶联为尿素合成提供了一条可持续的途径。然而，受不明确的中间反应途径的限制，此类系统通常需要高负电势（≤ -0.5 V vs RHE）才能实现高尿素产率。这不可避免地导致高昂的电力费用，约占尿素电合成总支出的 48%，是阻碍这一有希望的方法的主要瓶颈。在此，报道了一种矢量控制的 *CO 中间运输策略来指导耦合途径。该策略在-0.2 V（相对于 RHE）下实现了 300 mV 的阳极电位变化和 2927 μg h–1 cm–2 的显着尿素产量，优于大多数报道的电催化剂。技术经济分析表明，这一过程可减少能源消耗，并将电力成本降低 25% 以上。这种单向 *CO 传输是通过精确设计的 CuAg 界面实现的，其中 d 带中心差为 1.64 eV 的定制不对称局部电子环境导致 *CO 吸附能差为 0.8 eV。这使得*CO能够从弱吸附Ag位点连续解吸，并单向传输到强吸附Cu位点，从而促进关键的*NOCO形成。这项工作为节能尿素合成建立了一条有前途的途径。

articles.title:
How Are We Exposed
to Chemicals When Drugs Are Smoked
Indoors?
articles.abstract: Abstract Indoor smoking of psychoactive substances exposes not only users through “firsthand smoke” (FHS) but also bystanders through pathways of “secondhand smoke” (SHS; exhaled or side-stream smoke) and “thirdhand smoke” (THS; residual contamination that persists indoors) via different routes of inhalation, mouthing-mediated ingestion, and dermal absorption. Here, we explore how chemical properties, smoking behaviors, and features of exposed individuals together shape exposure pathways and routes, using a mechanistic indoor chemical fate and exposure model with scenarios varying by retention rate (the fraction of smoke-generated chemicals absorbed by the smoker) and smoking frequency. We estimate adult and child exposure to seven representative compounds spanning orders-of-magnitude differences in volatility and hydrophobicity. We find that dominant exposure pathways and routes are strongly chemical-specific and scenario-dependent. FHS is consistently the dominant exposure pathway for substance users, whereas among nonsmoking exposed individuals, the relative importance of SHS and THS is determined jointly by chemical partitioning properties and the relative durations of active-smoking and postsmoking periods. Exposure to volatile chemicals (e.g., nicotine) is dominated by inhalation, exposure to compounds with intermediate hydrophobicity by dermal absorption, while highly hydrophobic, lowly volatile compounds (e.g., Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol) receive meaningful contributions from all three routes. These findings highlight that broad generalizations about exposure dominance can misrepresent risks, particularly for nonusers and children.
articles.title_zh:
我们如何暴露
吸毒时接触化学物质
在室内？
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 室内吸食精神活性物质不仅会通过“一手烟”（FHS）暴露使用者，还会通过不同的吸入途径、口腔介导的摄入和皮肤吸收，通过“二手烟”（SHS；呼出或侧流烟雾）和“三手烟”（THS；室内持续的残留污染）途径使旁观者暴露。在这里，我们使用机械室内化学命运和暴露模型，探索化学性质、吸烟行为和暴露个体的特征如何共同塑造暴露途径和途径，其中场景随保留率（吸烟者吸收的烟雾产生的化学物质的比例）和吸烟频率而变化。我们估计了成人和儿童接触七种代表性化合物的情况，这些化合物的挥发性和疏水性存在数量级的差异。我们发现主要的暴露途径和途径具有很强的化学特异性和情景依赖性。 FHS 始终是物质使用者的主要暴露途径，而在不吸烟暴露个体中，SHS 和 THS 的相对重要性由化学分配特性以及主动吸烟和吸烟后时期的相对持续时间共同决定。接触挥发性化学物质（例如尼古丁）主要是通过吸入，接触具有中等疏水性的化合物是通过皮肤吸收，而高度疏水性、低挥发性化合物（例如Δ9-四氢大麻酚）则从所有三种途径中获得有意义的贡献。这些发现强调，对暴露主导的广泛概括可能会歪曲风险，特别是对于非使用者和儿童而言。

articles.title:
Design and Demonstration
of a Direct Air Capture System
with Moisture-Driven CO2 Delivery into Aqueous Medium
articles.abstract: Abstract Two direct air capture (DAC) systems were designed and demonstrated to passively capture CO2 from ambient air and use moisture to release the CO2 into an alkaline medium. A bench-scale system delivering ∼1 g CO2 d–1 was demonstrated in a laminar flow hood, and a small pilot-scale system that could deliver ∼100 g CO2 d–1 was operated outdoors in a 4.2 m2 raceway pond. Novel elongated mesh-tube packets containing anion-exchange resin (AER) beads were found to reduce drying and CO2 loading time 4.3-fold compared to larger mesh bags. Technoeconomic analysis (TEA) estimates the cost of capturing CO2 into an alkaline solution, suitable for cultivating photosynthetic microorganisms, to be $229 per tonne for a practical scenario based on current results and $72 per tonne for an aspirational scenario considering improvements to sorbent capacity, hydrophobicity, and sorbent lifetime. TEA further estimates an additional $110 per tonne to extract CO2 from solution, purify it, and compress it to 15 MPa, suitable for sequestration. Moisture-driven processes have the potential to use up to 87% less energy than thermal and/or vacuum swing DAC by using energy from water evaporation.
articles.title_zh:
设计与演示
直接空气捕获系统
将水分驱动的 CO2 输送到水性介质中
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 设计并演示了两种直接空气捕获 (DAC) 系统，可从环境空气中被动捕获 CO2，并利用水分将 CO2 释放到碱性介质中。在层流罩中演示了可提供约 1 g CO2 d–1 的实验室规模系统，并在室外 4.2 m2 跑道池中运行了可提供约 100 g CO2 d–1 的小型中试规模系统。研究发现，与较大的网袋相比，含有阴离子交换树脂 (AER) 珠的新型细长网管包可将干燥和 CO2 装载时间缩短 4.3 倍。技术经济分析 (TEA) 估计，根据目前的结果，将 CO2 捕获到适合培养光合微生物的碱性溶液中的成本为每吨 229 美元，考虑到吸附剂容量、疏水性和吸附剂寿命的改进，理想情况下的成本为每吨 72 美元。 TEA 进一步估计每吨额外花费 110 美元，用于从溶液中提取二氧化碳、净化二氧化碳并将其压缩至适合封存的 15 MPa。通过利用水蒸发的能量，湿气驱动工艺的能耗比热和/或真空摆动 DAC 的能耗可减少高达 87%。

articles.title: Wastewater-Derived Comammox Nitrospira for Next-Generation Wastewater Management
articles.abstract: Abstract The discovery of complete ammonia-oxidizing (comammox) Nitrospira in 2015 marked a major advance in our understanding of the nitrogen cycle and demonstrated that a single microorganism can catalyze the full oxidation of ammonia to nitrate, challenging the long-standing paradigm that separates ammonia- and nitrite-oxidizing microorganisms. Over the past decade, research on comammox has progressed rapidly from genomic discovery to detailed characterization of its physiology, kinetics, and ecological distribution across natural and engineered ecosystems. Wastewater-derived comammox Nitrospira have emerged as influential players in biological nitrogen transformations due to their exceptionally high substrate affinities, metabolic versatility, potentially low nitrous oxide emissions, and resilience under resource-limited conditions. These traits position comammox as promising catalysts for low-energy and sustainable nitrogen management in engineered systems. This review synthesizes the first decade of research on comammox Nitrospira, with a particular focus on wastewater-associated lineages. We examine the ecological niches that enable comammox Nitrospira to thrive in wastewater environments and analyze their competitive and cooperative interactions with canonical ammonia- and nitrite-oxidizing microorganisms. Building on these ecological insights, we discuss emerging comammox-centered biotechnological strategies for next-generation wastewater treatment and resource recovery. By linking microbial ecology with process engineering, this review highlights the potential for comammox-driven innovations to advance circular and energy-efficient nitrogen management in the coming decade.
articles.title_zh: 废水衍生 氨氧化酶 硝化螺旋 用于下一代废水处理 管理
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 2015 年完全氨氧化（comammox）Nitrospira 的发现标志着我们对氮循环理解的重大进步，并证明单一微生物可以催化氨完全氧化为硝酸盐，挑战了长期以来区分氨氧化微生物和亚硝酸盐氧化微生物的范式。在过去的十年中，comammox 的研究迅速进展，从基因组发现到其生理学、动力学和在自然和工程生态系统中的生态分布的详细表征。源自废水的comammox Nitrospira因其极高的底物亲和力、代谢多功能性、潜在的低一氧化二氮排放以及在资源有限条件下的恢复能力而成为生物氮转化中具有影响力的参与者。这些特性使comammox成为工程系统中低能耗和可持续氮管理的有前景的催化剂。本综述综合了前十年对comammox Nitrospira 的研究，特别关注与废水相关的谱系。我们研究了使comammox Nitrospira在废水环境中茁壮成长的生态位，并分析了它们与典型的氨氧化和亚硝酸盐氧化微生物的竞争和合作相互作用。基于这些生态见解，我们讨论了以comammox为中心的下一代废水处理和资源回收的新兴生物技术策略。通过将微生物生态学与过程工程联系起来，这篇综述强调了comammox驱动的创新在未来十年推进循环和节能氮管理的潜力。

articles.title:
Multi-Element
(C, N, Cl) Stable Isotope Fractionation
During Reductive Dechlorination of Chloroanilines
articles.abstract: Abstract Compound-specific isotope analysis (CSIA) is widely used to verify in situ biodegradation of organic contaminants. Chloroanilines are persistent groundwater pollutants known to undergo reductive dechlorination under environmental conditions, yet their isotope fractionation remains unclear. This study reports multi-element isotopic fractionation (ε) associated with reductive dechlorination of 2,3-dichloroaniline (2,3-DCA) and 2-chloroaniline (2-CA) using a Dehalobacter-dominated enrichment culture. During 2,3-DCA dechlorination, significant C (εC = −8.1 ± 0.3‰) and Cl (εCl = −7.5 ± 0.1‰) isotope fractionation was observed (ΛC–Cl = 1.12 ± 0.09), while N isotope fractionation was insignificant (Δδ15N < 1‰). Similarly, reductive dechlorination of 2-CA yielded εC = −8.9 ± 0.3‰ and εCl = −18.1 ± 0.4‰ (ΛC–Cl = 0.48 ± 0.03), with negligible changes in δ15N. The large and comparable apparent kinetic isotope effects for C and Cl may suggest that both reactions share similar transition-state characteristics, with C–Cl bond cleavage as the rate-limiting step. In contrast to isotope fractionation reported for aerobic 2,3-DCA biodegradation, the distinct isotope patterns observed here enable differentiation between aerobic and anaerobic pathways. Using groundwater samples from a chloroaniline-impacted aquifer, we show that multi-element CSIA can help distinguish reductive dechlorination from aerobic biodegradation under spatially and temporally variable redox conditions.
articles.title_zh:
多元素
(C, N, Cl) 稳定同位素分馏
氯苯胺还原脱氯过程中
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 化合物特异性同位素分析（CSIA）广泛用于验证有机污染物的原位生物降解。氯苯胺是持久性地下水污染物，已知在环境条件下会发生还原脱氯，但其同位素分馏仍不清楚。本研究报告了使用 Dehalobacter 为主的富集培养物与 2,3-二氯苯胺 (2,3-DCA) 和 2-氯苯胺 (2-CA) 还原脱氯相关的多元素同位素分馏 (ε)。在2,3-DCA脱氯过程中，观察到显着的C（εC = -8.1 ± 0.3‰）和Cl（εCl = -7.5 ± 0.1‰）同位素分馏（ΛC–Cl = 1.12 ± 0.09），而N同位素分馏不显着（Δδ15N < 1‰）。类似地，2-CA 的还原脱氯产生 εC = −8.9 ± 0.3‰ 和 εCl = −18.1 ± 0.4‰ (ΛC–Cl = 0.48 ± 0.03)，δ15N 的变化可以忽略不计。 C 和 Cl 的大且可比较的表观动力学同位素效应可能表明这两个反应具有相似的过渡态特征，其中 C-Cl 键断裂是限速步骤。与有氧 2,3-DCA 生物降解报道的同位素分馏相反，这里观察到的不同同位素模式能够区分需氧和厌氧途径。使用来自受氯苯胺影响的含水层的地下水样品，我们表明多元素 CSIA 可以帮助区分空间和时间变化的氧化还原条件下的还原脱氯和需氧生物降解。

articles.title:
Interactions between
a Methanogenic Archaeon and Synthetic
Musk Tonalide: A Balance of Cellular Inhibition and Detoxifying Biotransformation
articles.abstract: Abstract The widespread use of synthetic musks, such as tonalide (AHTN), has led to their accumulation in anaerobic environments, such as sludge and sediments, raising concerns about their ecological impact. While methanogenic archaea are key ecological players in these environments, their responses to synthetic musks remain poorly understood. This study provides a systematic investigation of the interaction between AHTN and model methanogenic archaeon Methanosarcina acetivorans C2A. We found that AHTN toxicity is dependent on concentration, with 2 mg/L significantly inhibiting methanogenesis and growth by inducing oxidative stress and compromising cell membrane integrity. Despite this effect, M. acetivorans C2A was found to partially biotransform AHTN, achieving a value of 17.75% within 36 h. Using GC-MS/MS, six mono- and dihydroxylated metabolites were tentatively identified, indicating oxidation as the primary transformation mechanism. Notably, ecotoxicity modeling (ECOSAR) predicted these metabolites to be substantially less toxic than the parent AHTN, suggesting that this biotransformation is a detoxification pathway. These findings present the first evidence of archaeally mediated biotransformation of AHTN, revealing a dual role for methanogens as both targets of pollution and active agents in its natural attenuation.
articles.title_zh:
之间的相互作用
产甲烷古菌和合成物
麝香托纳内酯：细胞抑制与解毒生物转化的平衡
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 合成麝香（如托纳内酯（AHTN））的广泛使用导致其在污泥和沉积物等厌氧环境中积累，引起了人们对其生态影响的担忧。虽然产甲烷古菌是这些环境中的关键生态参与者，但它们对合成麝香的反应仍然知之甚少。本研究对 AHTN 与模型产甲烷古菌 Methanosarcina acetivorans C2A 之间的相互作用进行了系统研究。我们发现 AHTN 毒性取决于浓度，2 mg/L 会通过诱导氧化应激和损害细胞膜完整性来显着抑制产甲烷和生长。尽管存在这种影响，但发现 M. acetivorans C2A 可以部分生物转化 AHTN，在 36 小时内达到 17.75% 的值。使用 GC-MS/MS，初步鉴定了六种单羟基和二羟基代谢物，表明氧化是主要的转化机制。值得注意的是，生态毒性模型 (ECOSAR) 预测这些代谢物的毒性远低于母体 AHTN，表明这种生物转化是一种解毒途径。这些发现提供了古菌介导的 AHTN 生物转化的第一个证据，揭示了产甲烷菌作为污染目标和自然衰减活性剂的双重作用。

articles.title:
Iron-Doped
Carbon Nanotubes Facilitate ZnO Interfacial
Charge Accumulation for Selective Singlet Oxygen Generation in Piezo-Photocatalytic
Microplastics Upcycling
articles.abstract: Abstract Efficient catalytic upcycling of microplastics (MPs) remains challenging due to uncontrolled reactive oxygen species (ROS) evolution pathways and the reliance on predepolymerization of MPs prior to catalytic conversion. Here, we demonstrate that interfacial band engineering in an iron-doped carbon nanotube (CNFe)-mediated zinc oxide/carbon nitride (ZnO/DCN-Cg, ZCN) heterojunction enables selective ROS steering toward a dominant nonradical pathway. The ZCNCNFe nanocomposite, featuring N–Zn bonding, C–O–Zn coordination, and C–C conjugation, provides a structurally integrated platform that dynamically regulates interfacial charge transfer during peroxymonosulfate activation, resulting in singlet oxygen (1O2) as the dominant ROS with a high yield (67.71 μmol/L). Notably, real-world HDPE MPs (∼700 mg), directly extracted from commercial facial cleansers via a novel dual-density separation method, were selectively oxidized into oxygenated intermediates (e.g., carboxylic acids and esters) without any predepolymerization, rather than being fully mineralized (∼39.2 wt % weight loss, TOC = 14.06 mg/L), accompanied by pronounced surface erosion and fragmentation under piezo-photocatalysis. The introduction of CNFe triggers Fermi-level realignment to accelerate interfacial charge flux toward ZnO adsorption sites, promoting peroxo bond polarization and cleavage, driving the self-disproportionation of HSO5– to generate 1O2. This study establishes a charge-transfer-regulated framework for steering ROS pathways in piezo-photocatalytic systems, challenging conventional radical-dominated approaches for microplastics upcycling.
articles.title_zh:
掺铁
碳纳米管有利于 ZnO 界面
压电光催化中选择性单线态氧生成的电荷积累
微塑料升级再造
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 由于不受控制的活性氧 (ROS) 演化途径以及催化转化前对 MP 预解聚的依赖，微塑料 (MP) 的高效催化升级改造仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们证明了铁掺杂碳纳米管（CNFe）介导的氧化锌/氮化碳（ZnO/DCN-Cg，ZCN）异质结中的界面带工程能够选择性地将ROS转向主导的非自由基途径。 ZCNCNFe纳米复合材料具有N-Zn键合、C-O-Zn配位和C-C共轭等特点，提供了一个结构集成的平台，可以在过一硫酸盐活化过程中动态调节界面电荷转移，从而以单线态氧（1O2）作为主要ROS，并具有高产率（67.71 μmol/L）。值得注意的是，通过新型双密度分离方法直接从商业洗面奶中提取的现实世界中的 HDPE MP（~700 mg），在没有任何预解聚的情况下被选择性氧化成含氧中间体（例如羧酸和酯），而不是完全矿化（~39.2 wt% 重量损失，TOC = 14.06 mg/L），并在压电光催化下伴随着明显的表面侵蚀和破碎。 CNFe的引入引发费米能级重排，加速界面电荷通量流向ZnO吸附位点，促进过氧键极化和裂解，驱动HSO5–自歧化生成1O2。这项研究建立了一个电荷转移调节框架，用于控制压电光催化系统中的 ROS 路径，挑战传统的自由基主导的微塑料升级回收方法。

articles.title:
Potential of Microalgal
Biomass Production in Coastal
Deserts for Carbon Dioxide Removal
articles.abstract: Abstract High photosynthetic yields and the ability to grow without fresh water make microalgae interesting mechanisms for carbon dioxide removal (CDR). We characterize two CDR systems which grow microalgae in seawater in coastal deserts─microalgal bioenergy with carbon capture and storage and microalgal biomass burial─and evaluate their potential when using carbon sourced from the atmosphere or ocean to meet CDR objectives via a comparison with direct air carbon capture and storage (DACCS). By deriving and validating a theoretical model of chemically enhanced carbon dioxide mass transfer, we identify the importance of gas–liquid mass transfer into raceway ponds as limiting microalgal productivities and determining technoeconomic viability. Our analysis shows that, while microalgal CDR cannot compete with DACCS in the areal productivity of removals, net removal costs with marine carbon supply are only slightly higher than DACCS with prospects for parity. Though such outcomes may not yet support the use of microalgal biomass for CDR, the carbon supply apparatuses outlined and the theoretical models accompanying them can inform ongoing research into microalgal cultivation without carbon addition for diverse applications.
articles.title_zh:
微藻的潜力
沿海生物质生产
沙漠去除二氧化碳
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 高光合产量和无需淡水即可生长的能力使微藻成为二氧化碳去除（CDR）的有趣机制。我们描述了在沿海沙漠海水中生长微藻的两种 CDR 系统（具有碳捕获和储存的微藻生物能源和微藻生物质埋藏），并通过与直接空气碳捕获和储存 (DACCS) 进行比较，评估了它们在使用来自大气或海洋的碳来实现 CDR 目标时的潜力。通过推导和验证化学增强二氧化碳传质的理论模型，我们确定了气液传质进入跑道池的重要性，因为它限制了微藻生产力并确定了技术经济可行性。我们的分析表明，虽然微藻 CDR 在清除面积生产力方面无法与 DACCS 竞争，但海洋碳供应的净清除成本仅略高于 DACCS，且具有同等前景。尽管这些结果可能尚不支持使用微藻生物质进行 CDR，但概述的碳供应装置及其随附的理论模型可以为正在进行的不添加碳的微藻培养研究提供信息，以用于不同的应用。

articles.title:
Exploring
the High
Summertime Surface Ozone-Temperature
Sensitivity in China
articles.abstract: Abstract Ozone-temperature sensitivity measures the increase in ozone concentration per Kelvin rise in temperature, serving as a critical metric for assessing ozone responses to climate warming. Here, from extensive observations across the Northern Hemisphere, we show that China exhibits a remarkably higher present-day (2017–2024) summertime surface ozone-temperature sensitivity (mΔO3-ΔTmax; 3.7 ppbv K–1) compared to the US (1.6 ppbv K–1) and Europe (1.8 ppbv K–1), with extremely high values reaching 8–10 ppbv K–1 at the site level. GEOS-Chem model simulations with improved accuracy in reproducing observed mΔO3-ΔTmax attribute this elevated sensitivity predominantly to temperature-indirect effects (66%), comprising comparable contributions from temperature-associated changes in radiation (44%) and transport patterns (51%). These indirect effects dominate the spatial and interannual variability of mΔO3-ΔTmax in China. Direct temperature effects on emissions, chemistry, and deposition account for the remaining 34%. Global models project that stringent emission reductions will decrease China’s future mΔO3-ΔTmax to levels comparable to those of the US and Europe, highlighting emission levels as the primary determinant of the magnitude of ozone-temperature sensitivity. These findings emphasize that sustained emission controls are crucial for mitigating the risks associated with compound heat and ozone pollution.
articles.title_zh:
探索
高
夏季地表臭氧温度
中国的敏感性
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 臭氧温度敏感性测量温度每升高一开尔文，臭氧浓度的增加量，作为评估臭氧对气候变暖反应的关键指标。在这里，通过对北半球的广泛观测，我们发现，与美国（1.6 ppbv K-1）和欧洲（1.8 ppbv K-1）相比，中国目前（2017-2024）夏季表面臭氧温度敏感性（mΔO3-ΔTmax；3.7 ppbv K-1）显着更高，现场值极高，达到8-10 ppbv K-1水平。 GEOS-Chem 模型模拟在再现观测到的 mΔO3-ΔTmax 方面具有更高的准确性，这主要归因于温度间接效应 (66%)，其中包括与温度相关的辐射 (44%) 和传输模式 (51%) 变化的类似贡献。这些间接影响主导了中国 mΔO3-ΔTmax 的空间和年际变化。温度对排放、化学和沉积的直接影响占剩余的 34%。全球模型预测，严格的减排将使中国未来的 mΔO3-ΔTmax 降低至与美国和欧洲相当的水平，这凸显了排放水平是臭氧-温度敏感性大小的主要决定因素。这些发现强调，持续的排放控制对于减轻与复合热和臭氧污染相关的风险至关重要。

articles.title:
Health Risk of Fine
Particulate Matter Across China
with a Pollutant-Specific Index from 2013 to 2023
articles.abstract: Abstract Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) remains a major public health challenge in China despite substantial improvements in air quality over the past decade. Assessments of PM2.5 distribution and its associated health risks are essential for pollution control and health protection. Thus, we developed a 1-km resolution daily PM2.5 estimation model using machine learning approaches from 2013 to 2023 across China. Meta-analyses were further conducted to estimate the short-term health effects of PM2.5 exposure on mortality and hospitalization outcomes. We integrated PM2.5 concentration and its health effect into a PM2.5-specific Air Quality Health Index (AQHIPM2.5) to quantify region-specific health risks. The model achieved high predictive accuracy (cross-validation R2 = 0.88 spatially and 0.82 temporally at daily level). PM2.5 concentrations declined substantially nationwide from 55.06 μg/m3 in 2013 to 26.50 μg/m3 in 2022, followed by a slight rebound to 27.46 μg/m3 in 2023. Each 10 μg/m3 increase in short-term PM2.5 exposure within 3 days was associated with increased risks of all-cause (0.42%), cardiovascular (0.61%), and respiratory (0.84%) mortality. AQHIPM2.5 indicated persistent moderate-to-high health risk days in northern and southwestern China, with some regions experiencing more than 80 medium- and high-risk days annually. Eliminating high-risk days identified by AQHIPM2.5 could avert an estimated 6,985 (95% CI: 6,419 to 7,588) deaths in 2023, accounting for 7.42% of PM2.5-attributable all-cause mortality burden. These findings indicate that substantial health risks from PM2.5 persist despite improved air quality and demonstrate that integrating high-resolution exposure estimation with health risk assessment can support more targeted pollution control and public health interventions.
articles.title_zh:
罚款的健康风险
中国各地的颗粒物
2013 年至 2023 年污染物特定指数
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管过去十年空气质量有了显着改善，但细颗粒物（PM2.5）仍然是中国的一项重大公共卫生挑战。 PM2.5分布及其相关健康风险的评估对于污染控制和健康保护至关重要。因此，我们利用机器学习方法开发了 2013 年至 2023 年全国范围内 1 公里分辨率的每日 PM2.5 估算模型。进一步进行荟萃分析，以估计 PM2.5 暴露对死亡率和住院结果的短期健康影响。我们将 PM2.5 浓度及其健康影响纳入 PM2.5 特定空气质量健康指数 (AQHIPM2.5)，以量化特定地区的健康风险。该模型实现了较高的预测准确性（日常水平的空间交叉验证 R2 = 0.88，时间交叉验证 R2 = 0.82）。全国范围内 PM2.5 浓度从 2013 年的 55.06 μg/m3 大幅下降至 2022 年的 26.50 μg/m3，随后小幅反弹至 2023 年的 27.46 μg/m3。3 天内短期 PM2.5 暴露量每增加 10 μg/m3，与全因 (0.42%)、心血管疾病的风险增加相关（0.61%）和呼吸系统死亡率（0.84%）。 AQHIPM2.5表明中国北部和西南部地区持续存在中高风险天数，部分地区每年出现中高风险天数超过80天。消除 AQHIPM2.5 确定的高风险日期预计可在 2023 年避免 6,985 人（95% CI：6,419 至 7,588）人死亡，占 PM2.5 可归因的全因死亡负担的 7.42%。这些研究结果表明，尽管空气质量有所改善，PM2.5 带来的重大健康风险仍然存在，并表明将高分辨率暴露估计与健康风险评估相结合可以支持更有针对性的污染控制和公共卫生干预措施。

articles.title:
Overestimation of
Stratospheric Intrusion Impacts
on Surface Ozone in China
articles.abstract: Abstract Several recent studies suggest stratospheric intrusion (SI) substantially influences surface ozone (O3) in China, sparking widespread discussion. Using observations from over 1,400 national stations (predominantly urban sites susceptible to strong nitric oxide titration) and multiple data sets (including ERA5 meteorology and stratospheric O3 tracers of EAC4 and WACCM) from 2015 to 2024, this study systematically investigates and quantifies the impact of SI on surface O3 in China. Over the past decade, we identified 21,306 SI-to-surface (SITS) events (mean: 1.5 events/station/year; max: 12.5 events/station/year). SI signals are more prominent during winter and spring or under conditions of weak local photochemistry (e.g., nighttime). Notably, only 0.6% of total O3 pollution events (frequency) nationwide are induced by SITS. The average stratospheric O3 load and contribution to surface O3 during pollution periods are approximately 5 ppbv and 6%, respectively. Furthermore, SITS impact varies substantially with altitude: increasing significantly as altitude rises (<200 m (plains): 5 ppbv, >3000 m: 15 ppbv). Overall, SITS events are rare and mostly insufficient to trigger O3 pollution. The influence of SI on surface O3 has been significantly overestimated in previous research. This study quantifies SI’s actual role in surface O3 pollution, providing a scientific basis for relevant policy formulation.
articles.title_zh:
高估了
平流层入侵影响
中国地表臭氧研究
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 最近的几项研究表明，平流层入侵（SI）对中国表面臭氧（O3）有重大影响，引发了广泛的讨论。本研究利用 2015 年至 2024 年 1,400 多个国家站（主要是易受强一氧化氮滴定影响的城市站点）的观测数据和多个数据集（包括 ERA5 气象数据以及 EAC4 和 WACCM 的平流层 O3 示踪剂），系统地调查和量化了 SI 对中国地表 O3 的影响。在过去十年中，我们识别了 21,306 个 SI 到地面 (SITS) 事件（平均值：1.5 个事件/站/年；最大值：12.5 个事件/站/年）。 SI 信号在冬季和春季或局部光化学较弱的条件下（例如夜间）更为突出。值得注意的是，全国 O3 污染事件总数（频率）中只有 0.6% 是由 SITS 引起的。污染期间平流层的平均 O3 负荷和对地表 O3 的贡献分别约为 5 ppbv 和 6%。此外，SITS影响随海拔高度变化很大：随着海拔升高而显着增加(<200m(平原)：5ppbv，>3000m：15ppbv)。总体而言，SITS 事件很少见，而且大多不足以引发 O3 污染。先前的研究明显高估了SI对表面O3的影响。本研究量化了SI在地表O3污染中的实际作用，为相关政策制定提供科学依据。

articles.title:
30-Year
Greenhouse Gas Changes in Megacities Driven
by Emission Reduction Policies: A Case Study of Beijing
articles.abstract: Abstract This study investigates the spatiotemporal dynamics of urban greenhouse gases amidst energy transition, aiming to assess the emission reduction effectiveness of Beijing’s “coal-to-gas” and “coal-to-electricity” policies and to pinpoint the key sources arising from the subsequent structural shifts in the emission profile. We analyzed greenhouse gas concentrations from 1993 to 2024 using gas chromatography. Vertical profile data across the 8–240 m atmospheric layer from 2022 to 2024 were obtained using a pod-based measurement system installed on a 325-m meteorological tower. The results show that the CO2 growth rate initially increased and then decreased during the 1993–2024 period, and the difference in CO2 concentration between the ground and upper air decreased by 20–56% compared to the historical maxima. These trends demonstrate that the energy transition has effectively mitigated the increase in CO2 concentration. A concurrent deceleration in the growth rates of CH4 and N2O was also observed, albeit with less pronounced changes in their vertical gradients. This mitigation is largely linked to the shift from landfill disposal to waste incineration and the promotion of new energy vehicles. In contrast, SF6 emissions increased steadily from 2008 to 2024, primarily driven by growing electricity demand and the expansion of the semiconductor industry. The recent eight-year average growth rate reached 0.52 ppt yr–1. These findings underscore the power and semiconductor sectors as critical domains for targeted SF6 emission control.
articles.title_zh:
30年
特大城市驱动的温室气体变化
减排政策：以北京为例
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：本研究探讨能源转型过程中城市温室气体时空动态，旨在评估北京“煤改气”和“煤改电”政策的减排效果，并找出后续排放结构变化的关键来源。我们使用气相色谱分析了 1993 年至 2024 年的温室气体浓度。使用安装在 325 米气象塔上的基于吊舱的测量系统获得了 2022 年至 2024 年跨越 8-240 米大气层的垂直剖面数据。结果表明，1993—2024年期间CO2增长率先增后减，地面和高空CO2浓度差较历史最大值缩小了20%～56%。这些趋势表明，能源转型有效减缓了二氧化碳浓度的增加。还观察到 CH4 和 N2O 的生长速率同时减速，尽管它们的垂直梯度变化不太明显。这种缓解很大程度上与垃圾填埋处理向垃圾焚烧的转变以及新能源汽车的推广有关。相比之下，从 2008 年到 2024 年，SF6 排放量稳步增加，这主要是由于电力需求的增长和半导体行业的扩张。最近八年平均增长率达到0.52 ppt yr–1。这些发现强调电力和半导体行业是有针对性的 SF6 排放控制的关键领域。

articles.title:
Nanoscale Formation,
Structure, and Stability of Phosphate-Iron
Colloids at Anoxic-Oxic Interfaces
articles.abstract: Abstract The mobility of phosphorus (P) at anoxic–oxic interfaces is largely controlled by the formation of phosphate-iron (Fe) colloids, yet the nanoscale mechanisms underlying their formation, structure, and stability remain poorly described. Here, we systematically investigate these processes across a range of environmentally relevant conditions. Under anoxic conditions, phosphate-Fe(II) complexes exist predominantly as truly dissolved species. Upon transition into oxic conditions, phosphate-Fe(III) colloids form as a function of Fe/P molar ratio. At lower Fe/P ratios (e.g., ≤3), stable nanosized colloids (20–100 nm) form, whereas higher ratios (e.g., >3) promote aggregation into larger particles (>1000 nm) under the conditions tested. Structural analyses reveal that colloidal formation arises from a phosphate-stabilized, short-range ordered ferrihydrite phase, where phosphate inhibits Fe polymerization via corner-sharing Fe–O–P bonds and enhances electrostatic stabilization through surface enrichment. Natural organic matter (NOM, 2.5 and 10 mg C/L) promotes colloid generation under anoxic conditions and enhances stability at higher Fe/P ratios through electrostatic and steric interactions. Stability assessments in the tested water matrices show matrix-dependent persistence, with 0–41% of the colloids remaining suspended after 28 days without NOM, and substantially enhanced colloidal suspension (61–95%) in the NOM-amended system. This work provides mechanistic insight into one important pathway that may contribute to P mobility under redox-transition conditions.
articles.title_zh:
纳米级形成，
磷酸铁的结构和稳定性
缺氧-好氧界面处的胶体
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 磷（P）在缺氧-有氧界面的迁移率很大程度上受磷酸盐-铁（Fe）胶体形成的控制，但其形成、结构和稳定性的纳米级机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们系统地研究了一系列环境相关条件下的这些过程。在缺氧条件下，磷酸盐-Fe(II) 络合物主要以真正溶解的物质形式存在。转变为有氧条件后，磷酸盐-Fe(III) 胶体的形成与 Fe/P 摩尔比有关。在较低的 Fe/P 比率（例如，≤3）下，形成稳定的纳米级胶体（20-100 nm），而较高的比率（例如，> 3）则在测试条件下促进聚集成更大的颗粒（> 1000 nm）。结构分析表明，胶体形成源自磷酸盐稳定的短程有序水铁矿相，其中磷酸盐通过共享角的 Fe-O-P 键抑制 Fe 聚合，并通过表面富集增强静电稳定性。天然有机物（NOM，2.5 和 10 mg C/L）可促进缺氧条件下胶体的生成，并通过静电和空间相互作用增强较高 Fe/P 比下的稳定性。测试的水基质中的稳定性评估显示出基质依赖性持久性，在没有 NOM 的情况下 28 天后，0–41% 的胶体保持悬浮状态，并且在 NOM 修正系统中胶体悬浮状态显着增强 (61–95%)。这项工作提供了对可能有助于氧化还原转变条件下磷迁移率的一个重要途径的机制见解。

articles.title:
Electrochemically
Driven Sorbent-Mediated Recovery
of CO2 in Marine Inorganic Carbon Extraction Processes
articles.abstract: Abstract The oceans act as a sink for atmospheric CO2, absorbing more than a quarter of global emissions annually. Technologies for marine inorganic carbon dioxide removal (mCDR) have recently gained attention as a means of leveraging this effect to reduce environmental CO2 concentrations. In pH-swing mCDR systems, electrochemical acidification drives the conversion of dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) in seawater to CO2, which is then removed through vacuum stripping before the water is realkalinized and released to the ocean to draw down atmospheric carbon. While most research has focused on the pH-swing process itself, little attention has been devoted to the stripping step, which is particularly capital- and energy-intensive and indiscriminately removes dissolved oxygen, which is vital to marine life. In this work, we present a framework for an alternative sorbent-mediated CO2 concentration process, analyzing and experimentally demonstrating an electrochemically mediated embodiment. A comparative energetic and technoeconomic assessment is presented, evaluating performance relative to state-of-the-art vacuum processes and indicating that a sorbent-mediated extraction process can be a viable alternative.
articles.title_zh:
电化学
驱动吸附剂介导的回收
海洋无机碳提取过程中二氧化碳的排放
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋是大气二氧化碳的汇，每年吸收全球排放量的四分之一以上。海洋无机二氧化碳去除（mCDR）技术最近作为利用这种效应降低环境二氧化碳浓度的一种手段而受到关注。在 pH 摆动 mCDR 系统中，电化学酸化驱动海水中溶解的无机碳 (DIC) 转化为 CO2，然后通过真空汽提将 CO2 去除，然后将水重新碱化并释放到海洋以吸收大气中的碳。虽然大多数研究都集中在 pH 值波动过程本身，但很少关注剥离步骤，该步骤尤其需要大量资金和能源，并且会不加区别地去除溶解氧，而溶解氧对海洋生物至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了替代吸附剂介导的二氧化碳浓缩过程的框架，分析并通过实验证明了电化学介导的实施方案。提出了比较能量和技术经济评估，评估了相对于最先进的真空工艺的性能，并表明吸附剂介导的萃取工艺可以是一种可行的替代方案。

articles.title: Ultrashort-Chain Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances and Cholestasis: In Vitro Evidence of Liver Dysfunction from Emerging Environmental Contaminants
articles.abstract: Abstract Over the past 75 years, fluorinated contaminants present in aquatic, dietary, and environmental matrices have increasingly raised scientific and public health concerns. Among these substances, ultrashort perfluoroalkyl substances (US-PFAS) demonstrate substantial environmental persistence and mobility, comparable to that of their long-chain counterparts. Reported human serum concentrations of individual US-PFAS reach up to 27.7 ng/mL, substantially exceeding established thresholds for total PFAS levels. Nevertheless, data on human toxicity of US-PFAS remain limited. The present study aimed to investigate the impact of US-PFAS on cholestatic features and to elucidate the underlying mechanisms using an adverse outcome pathway network as a mechanistic compass. Human HepaRG liver cell cultures were exposed to 4 US-PFAS at various concentrations for 1 to 72 h. Transcriptomic profiles were assessed by RNA sequencing analysis. Functional alterations in early and key events associated with cholestatic pathology were evaluated using fluorescently labeled probes, while bile canaliculi dynamics were examined through in situ immunostaining and phase-contrast imaging. This revealed significant perturbations of molecular pathways involved in both early and late events relevant for cholestatic liver injury. US-PFAS did not significantly affect hepatocellular transporter activity or bile canalicular integrity at early time points (≤6 h). In contrast, prolonged exposure (24–72 h) to several US-PFAS elicited hepatocellular stress responses, such as oxidative stress and endoplasmic reticulum stress, and promoted inflammatory cell adhesion. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that US-PFAS have the capacity to affect biliary homeostasis and trigger downstream cholestatic events, providing mechanistic insight relevant for hazard identification.
articles.title_zh: 超短链 全氟烷基和多氟烷基物质 和胆汁淤积： 体外 肝功能障碍的证据 来自新兴环境污染物
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 在过去的 75 年里，水生、饮食和环境基质中存在的氟化污染物日益引起科学和公共卫生问题。在这些物质中，超短全氟烷基物质（US-PFAS）表现出与长链同类物质相当的显着环境持久性和流动性。据报道，个体 US-PFAS 的人血清浓度高达 27.7 ng/mL，大大超过了 PFAS 总水平的既定阈值。然而，有关 US-PFAS 的人体毒性的数据仍然有限。本研究旨在调查 US-PFAS 对胆汁淤积特征的影响，并使用不良结果途径网络作为机械指南针来阐明潜在机制。将人 HepaRG 肝细胞培养物暴露于不同浓度的 4 US-PFAS 中 1 至 72 小时。通过RNA测序分析评估转录组谱。使用荧光标记探针评估与胆汁淤积病理学相关的早期和关键事件的功能改变，同时通过原位免疫染色和相差成像检查胆小管动力学。这揭示了与胆汁淤积性肝损伤相关的早期和晚期事件中涉及的分子途径的显着扰动。 US-PFAS 在早期时间点（≤6 小时）不会显着影响肝细胞转运蛋白活性或胆管完整性。相反，长时间（24-72小时）接触几种US-PFAS会引发肝细胞应激反应，例如氧化应激和内质网应激，并促进炎症细胞粘附。总的来说，这些发现表明 US-PFAS 有能力影响胆汁稳态并触发下游胆汁淤积事件，为危险识别提供相关的机制见解。

articles.title:
Gamma-Irradiation-Enhanced
Reduction of 99Tc(VII) and Re(VII) by Natural Pyrite
articles.abstract: Abstract Reductive immobilization of 99Tc(VII) to sparingly soluble TcO2-type phases is a key process limiting 99Tc transport in the environment. However, the reactivity of natural pyrite toward 99Tc(VII) under conditions relevant to nuclear waste repositories remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the interactions of 99Tc(VII) and its nonradioactive congener Re(VII) with natural pyrite under γ-irradiation (0–100 kGy; 0–100 Gy/min). In the absence of γ-irradiation, natural pyrite exhibited limited reactivity toward 99Tc(VII) at circumneutral to alkaline pH over the investigated time scales. Under γ-irradiation, however, pyrite-mediated reductive sequestration of both Tc(VII) and Re(VII) was substantially enhanced, producing a TcO2/TcOx-TcSx mixture and ReO2 as dominant reduction products. Mechanistic analyses indicate that radiolytically generated hydrated electrons (eaq–) and hydrogen radicals (·H) directly reduce TcO4– and ReO4–, while pyrite and dissolved Fe2+ scavenge hydroxyl radicals (·OH) and sustain a reducing interfacial environment. Under acidic conditions, protonation of eaq– to ·H limits Tc(VII)/Re(VII) reduction efficiency. At higher pH, OH– suppresses intermediate disproportionation, promoting efficient stepwise reduction via consecutive one-electron transfer from eaq–. These findings demonstrate that γ-irradiation fundamentally alters the redox reactivity of natural pyrite and promotes radionuclide immobilization under nuclear waste repository conditions, providing critical constraints for predicting long-term radionuclide transport in deep geological disposal systems.
articles.title_zh:
伽马射线增强
天然黄铁矿还原 99Tc(VII) 和 Re(VII)
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 99Tc(VII) 还原固定到难溶的 TcO2 型相中是限制 99Tc 在环境中传输的关键过程。然而，在与核废料储存库相关的条件下，天然黄铁矿对 99Tc(VII) 的反应性仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们研究了 99Tc(VII) 及其非放射性同源物 Re(VII) 与天然黄铁矿在 γ 辐射（0–100 kGy；0–100 Gy/min）下的相互作用。在没有 γ 辐射的情况下，天然黄铁矿在所研究的时间范围内在中性至碱性 pH 值下对 99Tc(VII) 表现出有限的反应性。然而，在 γ 辐射下，黄铁矿介导的 Tc(VII) 和 Re(VII) 的还原封存显着增强，产生 TcO2/TcOx-TcSx 混合物和 ReO2 作为主要还原产物。机理分析表明，辐射分解产生的水合电子（eaq–）和氢自由基（·H）直接还原TcO4–和ReO4–，而黄铁矿和溶解的Fe2+清除羟基自由基（·OH）并维持还原界面环境。在酸性条件下，eaq– 质子化为·H 限制了 Tc(VII)/Re(VII) 还原效率。在较高的 pH 值下，OH– 抑制中间歧化，通过 eaq– 的连续单电子转移促进有效的逐步还原。这些发现表明，γ-辐照从根本上改变了天然黄铁矿的氧化还原反应性，并促进核废料储存库条件下放射性核素的固定，为预测深层地质处置系统中的长期放射性核素迁移提供了关键约束。

articles.title:
A Potential Difference-Driven
Cascade Effect of Cathode
Biofilm–Plant Physiology Governs the Efficiency-Energy-Risk
Trade-Off in Constructed Wetland–Microbial Electrolysis Cells
articles.abstract: Abstract Conventional potential difference optimization in microbial electrolysis cell-integrated constructed wetlands (ECWs) treating antibiotic-laden wastewater frequently prioritizes single-dimensional removal efficiency, critically overlooking trade-offs with energy consumption and ecological risks. By evaluating four ECWs operated under varying potential differences treating chloramphenicol (CAP) wastewater via physicochemical metrics, multiomics, structural equation modeling, and comprehensive risk assessment, we identified a potential difference-driven “cathode biofilm–plant physiology” cascade effect governing this “efficiency-energy-risk” trade-off. Specifically, moderate potential differences (0.5 and 0.8 V) achieved superior total nitrogen (79.5–80.1%) and substantial CAP (90.9–92.5%) removal, driven by the selectively enriched electroactive, dissimilatory nitrate reduction to ammonium and CAP-degrading bacteria (e.g., Geobacter sp., Ectobacillus sp., Defluviilinea sp016789025). These microbiomes provided continuous ammonium supply, activating diverse plant nitrogen pathways and stimulating robust root radial oxygen loss to engineer a microoxic-anoxic microenvironment for comprehensive risk mitigation. Concurrently, relative to the 0.2 V control group, the 0.5 V condition minimized greenhouse gas emissions (a 49.2% reduction), lowered effluent ecotoxicity by 47.4%, and suppressed AMR risk by 56.0%, without incurring excess energy input. Ultimately, the optimal 0.5 V potential difference establishes a sustainable efficiency-energy-risk equilibrium, empowering ECWs as robust biogeochemical barriers under a unified “One Health” perspective.
articles.title_zh:
势差驱动
阴极级联效应
生物膜-植物生理学控制效率-能源-风险
人工湿地与微生物电解池的权衡
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：微生物电解池集成人工湿地（ECW）处理富含抗生素的废水时，传统的电势差优化经常优先考虑单维去除效率，严重忽视了能源消耗和生态风险之间的权衡。通过物理化学指标、多组学、结构方程模型和综合风险评估评估在不同电位差下处理氯霉素（CAP）废水的四个 ECW，我们确定了电位差驱动的“阴极生物膜-植物生理学”级联效应，控制着这种“效率-能源-风险”的权衡。具体而言，在选择性富集的电活性、异化硝酸盐还原为铵和 CAP 降解细菌（例如，Geobacter sp.、Ectobacillus sp.、Defluviilinea sp016789025）的驱动下，中等电位差（0.5 和 0.8 V）实现了优异的总氮 (79.5–80.1%) 和大量 CAP (90.9–92.5%) 去除。这些微生物群提供持续的铵供应，激活不同的植物氮途径并刺激强劲的根部径向氧损失，以设计微氧-缺氧微环境以全面缓解风险。同时，相对于 0.2 V 对照组，0.5 V 条件最大限度地减少了温室气体排放（减少了 49.2%），将废水生态毒性降低了 47.4%，并将 AMR 风险抑制了 56.0%，且不会产生过多的能量输入。最终，最佳的 0.5 V 电位差建立了可持续的效率-能源-风险平衡，使 ECW 在统一的“One Health”视角下成为强大的生物地球化学屏障。

articles.title:
DURABLE: A Workflow
for Determining Corrosion-Driving
and Protective Microbial Mechanisms
articles.abstract: Abstract Microbiologically influenced corrosion (MIC) threatens global infrastructure, causing billions of dollars in annual losses. Its persistence stems from unresolved mechanisms─particularly the metabolites produced by microorganisms that drive or inhibit corrosion─and the microbial community structures. Progress has been hindered by the absence of systematic workflows to rapidly and accurately identify MIC-relevant microorganisms and their functions. Here, we present DURABLE (Detection of Unique Corrosion Resistant or Accelerating Biologics in a Laboratory Environment), a pipeline that couples high-throughput microbial screening with genomic and metabolic workflows. We applied the DURABLE workflow to six diesel tank samples and revealed fuel-dependent microbial community structures, which showed greater diversity and evenness in bacterial communities than their fungal counterparts. The workflow used carbon steel beads to rapidly screen over 80 bacterial isolates for corrosive activity, reducing assay time to approximately 2 days compared with the conventional 30-day metal coupon test. More than 40 isolates were identified as corrosive. Further testing using mass spectrometry analysis revealed corrosion-associated metabolites, which were further validated using electrochemical assays. Thus, DURABLE achieved a ∼15-fold increase in screening speed and provided a scalable and mechanistic framework for dissecting MIC dynamics. We expect this advance will enable the development of precision mitigation strategies in hydrocarbon fuel infrastructure.
articles.title_zh:
耐用：工作流程
用于确定腐蚀驱动
和保护性微生物机制
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微生物腐蚀 (MIC) 威胁着全球基础设施，每年造成数十亿美元的损失。其持久性源于尚未解决的机制（尤其是驱动或抑制腐蚀的微生物产生的代谢物）以及微生物群落结构。由于缺乏快速准确识别 MIC 相关微生物及其功能的系统工作流程，进展受到阻碍。在这里，我们推出了 DURABLE（在实验室环境中检测独特的耐腐蚀或加速生物制剂），这是一种将高通量微生物筛选与基因组和代谢工作流程结合起来的管道。我们将 DURABLE 工作流程应用于六个柴油箱样品，并揭示了依赖燃料的微生物群落结构，其细菌群落比真菌群落具有更大的多样性和均匀性。该工作流程使用碳钢珠快速筛选 80 多种细菌分离株的腐蚀性活性，与传统的 30 天金属挂片测试相比，将测定时间缩短至大约 2 天。超过 40 种菌株被鉴定为具有腐蚀性。使用质谱分析进行的进一步测试揭示了与腐蚀相关的代谢物，并使用电化学测定进一步验证了这些代谢物。因此，DURABLE 的筛选速度提高了约 15 倍，并为剖析 MIC 动态提供了可扩展的机械框架。我们预计这一进展将有助于在碳氢化合物燃料基础设施中制定精确的缓解策略。

articles.title:
Anomalies of Net
Primary Productivity under Compound
Marine Heatwaves and Microplastics
articles.abstract: Abstract Marine heatwaves (MHW) and microplastics (MPs) pollution increasingly co-occur, yet the response of phytoplankton net primary production (NPP) to this compound condition remains incompletely characterized, in part because analyses confined to local conditions may overlook nonlocal influences. Here we developed an adaptive machine learning framework to evaluate global NPP anomalies under co-occurring MHW and MPs. The results indicate that comparable compound-stress regimes corresponded to divergent NPP outcomes depending on regional nutrient backgrounds: an anomalous increase coincided with nitrate replenishment in oligotrophic waters, whereas an anomalous decrease coincided with silicate accumulation in iron-limited, diatom-dominated waters. Furthermore, pronounced NPP anomalies frequently exhibited a geographic offset from heatwave cores, a spatial mismatch consistent with a shock-transmission-spillover (STS) framework, here interpreted as a spatial teleconnection between the thermal forcing and the ecological response. Pending in situ validation, these observed associations indicate that monitoring confined to thermal or pollution sources may misplace ecological risk. Consequently, these findings support a shift toward downstream monitoring along current pathways relevant to fisheries and carbon uptake.
articles.title_zh:
网络异常
复合条件下的初级生产力
海洋热浪和微塑料
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋热浪（MHW）和微塑料（MP）污染日益同时发生，但浮游植物净初级生产力（NPP）对这种复合条件的响应仍未完全表征，部分原因是仅限于局部条件的分析可能会忽视非局部影响。在这里，我们开发了一个自适应机器学习框架来评估同时发生的 MHW 和 MP 下的全球 NPP 异常。结果表明，根据区域营养背景，可比较的复合胁迫状况对应于不同的NPP结果：异常增加与寡营养水域中硝酸盐的补充同时发生，而异常减少与铁有限、硅藻为主的水域中硅酸盐的积累同时发生。此外，明显的NPP异常经常表现出与热浪核心的地理偏移，这是一种与冲击-传递-溢出（STS）框架一致的空间失配，这里解释为热强迫与生态响应之间的空间遥相关。在现场验证之前，这些观察到的关联表明，仅限于热源或污染源的监测可能会错失生态风险。因此，这些发现支持沿着当前与渔业和碳吸收相关的途径转向下游监测。
